title: Cozy Home 20 min from downtown.
description:
Great Location! Come and relax in this cozy house, safe neighborhood! If you want to visit downtown Nashville it will take you only 20 minutes to get there, 2 minutes from by-pass 386, 5 minutes from Interstate 65. 8 minutes from the lake, and a walking distance to Gleenbrook shopping center, 5 minutes from Walmart, 3 minutes from Sam’s club and The Street of Indian Lake.
Check-in is at 4:00 pm Check-out at 10:00am
_

The space
There is a private suite connected to the house, however it is completely separate and independent of where guests stay. There is a privacy fence and separate entrance to ensure complete security.
